#define j0 _j0

#define yn _yn

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -5.5000f);
  glRotatef(18.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(32.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  static float p, d, s, h;

  // --- Render State -------------------
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);

  // the sine's own cosine falloff eases each turnaround, so the pulse reverses
  // the moment it reaches a rail -- no hold. Wrap this in
  // smoothstep(-1, 1, k * sin(...)) with k > 1 to buy a dwell at the ends.
  p = 3 * sin(1.2 * t);

  for(i, -3, 4) {
    d = i - p;
    // s eases from 1 at the pulse to 0 two units away
    s = 1 - smoothstep(0, 2, abs(d));
    h = lerp(0.3, 1.15, s);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(i, 0, 0);
      // bars lean away from the pulse, hardest a bar-width off center and
      // upright right under it; clamp bounds the lean to the falloff radius,
      // where s has already faded to 0
      glRotatef(-27 * s * clamp(d, -2, 2), 0, 0, 1);
      glColor3f(lerp(0.2, 1, s), lerp(0.25, 0.55, s), lerp(0.9, 0.25, s));
      glTranslatef(0, h / 2, 0);
      glScalef(0.55, h, 0.55);
      glutSolidCube(1);
    glPopMatrix();
  }
